rca of the issue: N/A for this iteration — verifying non-regression of a previously-shipped fix. Original P0 RCA (recorded in prior iterations): AsyncIOMotorClient('mongodb+srv://…') performed a blocking DNS SRV lookup at construction, and utils/database.py did that at module-import scope, so uvicorn never bound :8001 → k8s readiness timeout → crash-loop. Fix: for SRV URIs, expose `db` and `client` as transparent _LazyMotorClient/_LazyMotorDatabase proxies that construct the real motor client on first attribute access; plain mongodb:// (preview + tests) stays eager and unchanged.
